# S1.9 — Land the configuration & composition model (§3.3, R-2.1.4 C0/Stage 1)

**Spec:** `spec/CANONICAL_SPEC.md` §3.3 (`R-2.1.4` — the C0/Stage-1 slice per
§3.3.13) · ADR-0023/0024/0025 (as amended) · ADR-0148 (taxonomy) ·
ADR-0143 D2 (L2 rule) · ADR-0036/0037 · CF-056
**Ticket:** `docs/tickets/013_S1.9__config-composition.md`
**Requirement ids stamped:** **R-2.1.4**
**Base:** `svitali/harnessharness-s1.8` (stacked) · **Stage:** 1 · **Live
stage:** offline-only

## Summary
Lands the §3.3 configuration & composition model as the new persistent crate
`crates/hh-assembly` — the assembly grammar carried as a data-only member of
the `hir/1` document (Q-L1-09), the closed `C-*` diagnostic taxonomy, and the
Stage-1 op set: `load`/`encode` (canonical codec, `load(encode(a)) = a`,
unknown non-`ext` keys refused), `validate_assembly` stages 1–5 + 7 (+7-L2 —
all reported, never fail-fast; 6a/6b `n/a{not_run}`; hosted roots `n/a{class}`
for 2/6/7-opacity), `resolve` — the single resolver feeding `hh-hir`'s `seal`
(CF-056) — `identity` (root `{semantic_id, version_id}` + both configuration
ids per §3.3.6), `diff` via `HirDiff` (not a separate object), in-process
`instantiate` stamping `lifecycle.component.bound` per binding, `verify_resume`
with the four Core rules and a content-addressed `diff_ref`, and
`link_precheck` — the `C-LINK-1` unpinned-selector refusal AC-CC-10 names for
the compiler's stage 1 (S1.10 consumes it).

`resolve` pins every `ComponentVariantRef` snapshot-confined
(`resolved{registry_snapshot_id, resolved_at}` recorded), substitutes every
`$param:`/`$entity:` marker, keeps secrets as channel names only (`C-SEC-1`),
materialises native slot bindings, and seals; `execute` mode refuses a revoked
head in the pinned closure (`C-REF-4 StaleIndex`, ADR-0037); resolving an
already-resolved-and-sealed document returns it byte-identically (rebuilt
`SealedDefinition`, never re-sealed — ADR-0240 §3). The class catalog is a
view — `Stage1Catalog` serves the two mandatory `exactly-one` classes
(`control_strategy`, `context_policy`), `RegistryCatalog` reads records
name-free from a `RegistryStore` (optionally snapshot-confined). The MUST-code
/ MUST-data lists and the migration-ladder rungs are published as data
(`boundary`); this crate's rung is `C0` (ADR-0240). `hh-ledger` gains the
registered `context.artefact.delivered` class — `verify_resume`'s T-LCD-13
removal witness.

`hh-hir` grows the additive surface the ops consume (CC8): `SlotBinding`/
`SlotBindings`/`ComponentVariantRef` records with selector-or-pinned
`RefVersion`, `ProfileRef::unbound()`, `seal` accepting a resolved `assembly`
section, granular assembly diff ops (`Rebind` on variant refs,
`ReplaceField` on `params`/`values`/`enabled`), and the public `wire` codec
wrappers the assembly schema reuses (CC7).

## Acceptance criteria (all Stage-1 ACs executable and green — 26 acceptance tests)
- **AC-CC-01** — every `ClassRecord.contract` is the operations/inputs/outputs/
  invariants/failure-modes shape (`C-CLASS-4` structural check). *Out-of-process
  stub half → DF-S1.9-1* (Stage 2, `plugin_abi/1`).
- **AC-CC-02 (T-08)** — `required_inputs ⊇ {ModelProfile, ResourceAccount}`
  enforced (`C-CLASS-5`); a `model_family`-conditioned variant registers,
  resolves and binds through the data-only path
  (`a_model_conditioned_variant_binds_without_touching_core`).
- **AC-CC-03** — `resolve` closed + secret-free + idempotent
  (`resolve(resolve(d))` byte-identical); identity is content-derived, so two
  authoring paths to identical resolved content yield one `semantic_id`.
- **AC-CC-04** — every diagnostic carries a JSON-pointer path and
  `source_layer` when layered; a clean assembly validates with zero errors;
  opacity → `n/a{not_run}` (Stage-3 half → DF-S1.9-2).
- **AC-CC-06 (T-10)** — `enabled=false` ablation is `ReplaceField`-shaped; a
  variant swap is `Rebind`; rename → only `SurfaceEdit`/same `semantic_id` is
  covered at the HIR layer (AC-IR-05).
- **AC-CC-07 (T-13)** — `verify_resume` refuses removal of a tool the ledger
  delivered (`context.artefact.delivered`), accepts additions, refuses a
  dialect change; `Compatible` carries `diff_ref`.
- **AC-CC-09** — ladder lists + rungs published as data; ADR-0240 states `C0`.
  *Cross-ADR rung audit → DF-S1.9-4* (CAP.1).
- **AC-CC-10 (CF-056)** — sealed definitions carry no selector;
  `link_precheck` refuses an unpinned selector with `C-LINK-1`.
  *Consumer half (the compiler's `link`) → DF-S1.9-3* (S1.10).
- **AC-CC-11** — every landed code has a fixture (per-code battery + the
  planted multi-error test returns every diagnostic). *Full corpus → DF-S1.9-2.*
- **AC-CC-12 (T-15)** — hosted root → stages 2, 6, 7-opacity `n/a{class}`.
- **AC-CC-13 (ADR-0143 D2)** — `suite_id`/`task_id`/`foreign_id`/split/family
  predicates anywhere are `C-LCD-4` **errors** at `validate_assembly` and at
  `resolve` (pre-`seal`); the reference document yields `[]`.

## What changed
- **`crates/hh-assembly/`** (new persistent crate): `grammar` (the typed
  `Assembly` + closed sums + `$param:`/`$entity:`/`$secret:` markers),
  `schema` (canonical codec + per-field `MergePolicy` table),
  `diagnostics` (closed `Code` taxonomy, `AssemblyDiagnostic`,
  `ValidationReport`, `StageOutcome`/`n/a`), `catalog` (`Stage1Catalog` +
  `RegistryCatalog`), `validate` (stages 1–5, 7, 7-L2), `resolve` (+ `Environment`
  `ResolveEnv`, `link_precheck`), `identity`, `diff`, `instantiate`
  (`VariantRuntime` trait, `BindContext{profile, accounting}`,
  `BindFailure`), `resume` (`verify_resume`, `LedgerView`, `BudgetGate`,
  `ResumeRule`), `events` (`lifecycle.component.bound` /
  `lifecycle.definition.changed` / `context.artefact.delivered` builders),
  `boundary` (MUST lists + `LadderRung`/`RUNG`).
- **`crates/hh-hir/`** — additive: slot-binding records/refs, unbound
  `ProfileRef`, resolved-assembly `seal`, granular assembly diff ops, public
  `wire` wrappers (`node_to_json`/`node_semantic_projection`), `+` tests
  (`assembly_slots.rs`, seal-identity additions).
- **`crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs`** — `context.artefact.delivered` row.
- **Tests** — `tests/acceptance.rs` (26) + `tests/common` fixtures + 3 unit.
- **Build memory** — ADR-0240 (+ index), `DEFERRALS.md` DF-S1.9-1…4 OPEN,
  `docs/build/runs/S1.9.md`, this PR body.

## Design decisions (ADR-0240)
- Assembly = a data-only member of the `hir/1` document; one persistent crate
  above hir/registry/ledger/identity/provenance/ontology/wire — §1.
- `resolve` is the single resolver feeding `seal` (CF-056) — §2.
- Idempotence by `SealedDefinition` reconstruction, never re-seal — §3.
- `verify_resume` is a typed verdict; diff-gate refusals map to `C-KERN-*` — §4.
- `link_precheck` lands the AC-CC-10 refusal now; `link` consumes at S1.10 — §5.
- Constraints diff at leaf granularity (no constraint node kind in HIR/1) — §6.
- `context.artefact.delivered` registered now (the removal witness) — §7.
- The boundary lists + rung are data — §8.
- The catalog is a view over the registry, never a second store (CC7) — §9.
